'''Lava Crabs (dangerous)''' are an [[Monsters|enemy]] found in [[the Mines]] after activating the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]] or during the [[Quests#Danger In The Deep|Danger In The Deep]] quest. 60 rock crabs (any type) need to be killed for the [[Adventurer's Guild#Monster Eradication Goals|Monster Eradication Goal]] at the [[Adventurer's Guild]].

==Behavior==
They disguise themselves as [[Mining#Mining Nodes|Gold Nodes]], sometimes surprising the player. When immobile, they are invulnerable to attack, though they can be hit with a [[Tools#Pickaxes|pickaxe]] to knock them back, making them mobile again.

==Strategy==
Lava Crabs may be differentiated from nodes by striking them with a [[Weapons|weapon]].  A Lava Crab will make a knocking sound and a zero damage indicator will pop up when hit with a weapon, while a node will not.

The Lava Crab can only be dealt damage if it is mobile, and not hiding beneath its shell. Strike an immobile Lava Crab with a [[Pickaxes|pickaxe]] to make it mobile again. 

Striking a Lava Crab with a [[Pickaxes|pickaxe]] enough times will knock the shell off of its back, and will cause it to flee. Alternatively, setting off a [[Crafting#Bombs|bomb]] near a Lava Crab can remove its shell, and will cause it to flee as well.
